## Motivation

The Beam 1.0 cookbook points users at the model-specific `lmsysorg/sglang:beam` image. Switch it to the standard `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` image.

## Modifications

- `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Reflection/Beam-1_0.mdx`: install accordion now runs `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:dev`.
- `docs/src/snippets/configs/reflection/beam-1.0.jsx`: `dockerImages` for B300, GB300, and H200 now use `lmsysorg/sglang:dev`, so the generated `docker run` commands match.

The benchmark records (`sglang_version: f7473673dd`) are left unchanged, since they describe the commit the results were verified on.

N/A (docs only).

files.patch:
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ tag: NEW
 <Accordion title="Install SGLang">
 
 ```bash Command
-docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:beam
+docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:dev
 ```
 
 For host setup, see [Install SGLang with Docker](/docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker). The command panel below has a **Python / Docker** toggle, with Python selected by default. The Python output is the bare `sglang serve` command: run it inside a container started from this image. The Docker output wraps the same command in `docker run`.
